analysis: {'Project A': {'Clarity of Value Proposition': '• Relatively clear, focusing on verifiable provenance and combating digital manipulation. However, the ‘ethical sourcing standards registry’ feels somewhat ambitious and lacks immediate clarity.', 'Market Size and Demand': '• Identifies a sizable market (brands, NGOs, impact investors) but the initial focus on procurement teams feels narrow. Demand validation is planned, which is good.', 'Feasibility and Development Plan': '• The core concept is feasible, and the proof-of-concept is a reasonable approach. The phased development (demo widget, technical proof-of-concept, pilot) is sensible. However, integrating with certification bodies is a significant undertaking.', 'Revenue Model and Sustainability': '• Subscription model is standard and plausible. The tiered pricing is a good starting point.', 'Differentiation': '• The heirloom-quality concept and protocol-agnostic design are differentiating factors, but the ‘machine-readable registry’ needs more concrete definition to truly stand out.', 'Impact and Evidence Plan': '• The planned KPI for the certification body partnership is a good start, but the impact needs to be demonstrated beyond a 50% reduction in verification time.', 'Risk Awareness and Mitigation': '• Demonstrates awareness of risks (manufacturing, integration challenges) and proposes mitigations (experience, limited scope). The focus on privacy is a positive risk mitigation.'}, 'Project B': {'Clarity of Value Proposition': '• Clearly articulates the problem (shallow depth of field in macro photography) and the solution (automated focus stacking). The emphasis on repeatability and accuracy is strong.', 'Market Size and Demand': '• Targets a well-defined niche (macro photographers) with clear use cases. The inclusion of a 360-degree spin option expands the potential market.', 'Feasibility and Development Plan': '• The prototype and proof-of-concept demonstrate functional operation. The phased roadmap is reasonable.', 'Revenue Model and Sustainability': '• No revenue model is explicitly defined, but the crowdfunding campaign aims to secure funding for production. The SDK approach is a good strategy.', 'Differentiation': '• The open design, SDK, and modularity are key differentiators. The optional turntables add value.', 'Impact and Evidence Plan': '• The showcased sample results (stacked images) provide evidence of functionality. The planned SDK support will enable further customization.', 'Risk Awareness and Mitigation': '• Acknowledges manufacturing challenges as the primary risk and outlines mitigation strategies (experience, limited scope). The open design reduces technical risk.'}}
